messages:
marco: Heads-up: Sylvan Data submitted a dispute for their June invoice. They sent samples and claim a ~1.73M embed overcount from a short proxy replay window where our edge ACKs and origin retried both accepted the same payloads. Can finance triage?
billing-bot: Automated alert: embed-dup-detect fired for sylvan_data (score: 0.92). Auto-created ticket BILL-1422.
rachel: what's the ingest window and any quick dedupe numbers? Marco, can you paste your query and sample rows?
marco: window: 2025-07-11 03:05:00 -> 03:12:00 UTC. Quick SQL I ran: 
```
select event_time, client_id, embed_count, delivery_path, payload_hash from embed_ingest where client_id='sylvan_data' and event_time between '2025-07-11 03:05' and '2025-07-11 03:12' order by event_time limit 50;
```
sample rows:
"2025-07-11T03:05:12Z sylvan_data 256 edge-us-west payload_f1e2..."
"2025-07-11T03:05:12Z sylvan_data 256 origin-us-west payload_a9b8..."
"2025-07-11T03:05:13Z sylvan_data 256 edge-us-west payload_f1e2..."
marco: Totals for window: raw accepted events attributed = 1,750,000. Unique payloads after sha256 dedupe = 17,500. Net duplicate deliveries = 1,732,500.
ton y: unit price from our pricing ledger for Sylvan is $0.00029 per embed. Preliminary credit = 1,732,500 * 0.00029 = $502.425 -> propose $502.43.
rachel: can we confirm whether duplicates are identical vectors or just metadata changes? Also verify if our edge returned 200 twice or if origin retried.
marco: I computed a content_hash (strip headers) and matched content_hash across duplicates; content_hash is identical. Edge logs show retransmit on connection reset and origin also retried because of a short-lived TCP flapping event at 03:05:11Z. Both sides accepted.
billing-bot: Note: ingest-edge reported connection-reset storm (metric edge.conn.reset spike) at 2025-07-11T03:05:11Z. Linked infra alert INFRA-558.
claims-ops: policy check: if identical payload (content_hash) accepted >1 times, finance typically credits duplicate accepted units. Sylvan is a standard enterprise account. Any contract language that changes this?
ton y: contract doesn't require idempotency; billing is based on accepted events. Finance precedent is to credit obvious duplicate accepts to keep churn down.
rachel: assemble a CREDIT-REQ with CSV (payload_hash, content_hash, event_ids, counts) and include a short mitigation plan. I'll spot-check ~30 samples.
marco: filing CREDIT-REQ-959 attached to BILL-1422 with CSV and a 100-sample extract. Estimated credit line: $502.43. Tagging ENG-RUNTIME and INFRA.
claims-ops: suggested mitigation: implement an ingest-layer de-dup keyed by content_hash for a 20s sliding window across edge->origin handoffs, and instrument edge to not ACK duplicate deliveries when origin already accepted a payload. Tag owner eng-runtime.
ton y: engineering action: owner=tony (eng-runtime) to create ENG-rt-330 to add 20s cross-edge dedupe and add telemetry to detect duplicate acceptance chains. ETA 2w.
rachel: spot-checked 30 pairs from the CSV, content_hash identical and payload bytes match. Approve full credit of $502.43 to Sylvan Data. :+1:
claims-ops: legal/ops note: include a short customer note explaining root cause and mitigation and that this credit is a one-time adjustment. Also include an ask for the customer's SDK vendor to enable idempotency keys.
marco: will issue adjustment invoice for $502.43 and send customer notification with the mitigation plan and ENG ticket links. Will close this thread once accounting confirms credit posted. :white_check_mark:
